name: Seishori Club ~Ippai Nuite Ageru♪~
original_name: 性処理くらぶ～いっぱいヌいてあげる♪～
source:
One day, I just think, "How is my life...? Just boring! I need girls!" I've never had sex.... I find a shop sign, "Zurikko Club". When I enter it, there is a pretty girl inside. She is my type.... I just fall in love with her soon....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天，我忽然想到：“我的人生究竟算什么…？无聊透顶！我需要女孩！”我从未做过爱…后来，我发现一块写着“Zurikko Club”的店铺招牌。走进去后，里面有一个漂亮女孩。她完全是我喜欢的类型…我很快就爱上了她…

[摘自ErogeShop]
